primary_question: Is original Double Bass observation preservation by frozen htdemucs_ft to JGA associated with temporal coincidence with original isolated-Kick observations?

primary.rule: sole primary Kick authority; unchanged JGA observation; chosen before outcome linkage because the in-drum close microphone is the attack-oriented isolated Kick channel
primary.KickOut_status: excluded from primary authority prospectively because its outside/resonant representation can add path/envelope differences; no outcome-based choice

secondary.rule: sole secondary close dynamic Kick authority observed by unchanged JGA; analogous isolated close Kick evidence, not identical acquisition

CED-VAL-006.original: 1055 Double Bass EME in frozen acceptance authority
CED-VAL-006.preservation: frozen htdemucs_ft M1 correspondence; 619 recovered, 436 missed

observation.replay: exact Kick EME producer coordinates and scientific population must agree

coincidence.distance: minimum absolute difference between an original Bass EME and any Kick EME on the shared distributed-file coordinate
coincidence.primary_binary: BASS_WITH_KICK if nearest distance <= 0.030 seconds; otherwise BASS_WITHOUT_KICK
coincidence.boundary_rule: exact Fraction coordinates; closed upper boundary assigned to the nearer/earlier listed band; no optimization

core_analysis.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for each probability; Newcombe unpooled Wilson interval for risk difference; log-Wald 95% intervals for relative risk and odds ratio, with 0.5 Haldane correction only if a cell is zero
core_analysis.test: two-sided Fisher exact test; descriptive association only

controls.event_density: for each Bass EME count other original Bass EME and Kick EME within closed +/-0.5 seconds; report coincidence/preservation within prospectively computed quartiles of each count; quartile edges derive from the full labelled-time population without preservation outcomes
controls.temporal_position: four equal-duration quarters of authoritative file scope; report stratum tables
controls.adjusted_model: fixed logistic regression by deterministic IRLS: recovered outcome; predictors Kick<=30ms, normalized time in [0,1], local Bass count, local Kick count; report adjusted Kick odds ratio, Wald 95% CI, convergence; no variable selection or interactions
controls.stratified: Mantel-Haenszel common odds ratio across temporal quarters and across joint density strata where tables are informative

substantial_negative_gate: primary CED-VAL-005 risk difference <= -0.10, its 95% Newcombe upper bound < 0, and two-sided Fisher p < 0.05
interpretation_firewall: Association only. No physical causation, production detector, onset change, genre/swing/walking-bass/kick-behavior/recording-practice/instrumentation cause, physical-onset, or harmonic recovery claim.
next_if_gate: Recommend exactly one separately approved post-transient pitched/harmonic-evidence experiment restricted to MISSED BASS_WITH_KICK; do not execute it here.
